title: Execute Orange Team Modernization, Rebranding to Health Suite & Baseline Quality Gate
details: Renamed project from iHealth to Health Suite, scaffolded .dev/ hub with multi-generational roadmap (Voice dictation, Receipt OCR, Health sync), scaffolded in-repo docs/ wiki, updated package metadata, verified Pest/Pint quality gate, and established .github/ CI governance suite.

title: Generate Recipe times out with 500 Server Error (Maximum execution time of 30 seconds exceeded)
details: Kitchen -> Recipes -> Generate Recipe throws a fatal 500 when the AI provider request exceeds PHP's 30s max_execution_time (seen in production.log against AiService::chatForRecipe()). Needs either a raised execution-time limit scoped to the AI request, an async/queued generation flow with polling, or a client-side timeout guard with a friendly retry message. Migrated from legacy BUGS.md open bug list.

title: macOS code signing + notarisation for native builds
details: Deferred from Native Packaging phase: requires an Apple Developer account. Current arm64/x64 builds use an ad-hoc signature (self-distribution only); Gatekeeper requires right-click-Open on first launch. Migrated from legacy CHECKLIST.md Phase 11.

title: Decide on full runtime rebrand of NativePHP app identity (NATIVEPHP_APP_ID, app data directory, demo domain)
details: Documentation, README, and package metadata have been rebranded from iHealth to Health Suite in this pass. Runtime identifiers were deliberately left untouched: NATIVEPHP_APP_ID=com.ihealth.app (.env, not tracked), which NativePHP uses to derive the on-disk app-data directory (~/Library/Application Support/ihealth/), plus the demo seeder email domain (demo@ihealth.test) and exported filename prefixes (ihealth-backup-*, ihealth-export-*). Changing NATIVEPHP_APP_ID would silently orphan any existing local SQLite database under the old app-data path. Requires an explicit data-migration step (copy/move the app-support directory, or a migration script) before the identifier is changed — present to user before executing per Present-Before-Fix protocol.

title: Update JLDN Frontmatter
details: Update the README.md frontmatter to include the new `type` and `platform` classification keys per the updated AGENTS.md schema.
